title: aiBytes edition index
description: content/index.json - the list of editions that exist. Drives the edition bar's prev/next arrows and the calendar popover, and is the one file a consumer must fetch before it knows what to fetch next. Deliberately lean: it carries what the bar and the calendar render, and nothing that would duplicate an edition file and drift from it.

schema_version.description: Bumped only for a breaking change. Consumers must refuse a version they do not know.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the run that last rewrote this index.

editions.description: Newest first, strictly descending by date with no duplicates - editions[0] is the latest, which is what `/` resolves to and what disables the next arrow. An empty array is valid: it is what the index says before the first edition is generated.

date.description: The edition's date, matching the `date` inside the edition file.

path.description: Path to the edition, relative to this index. Must stay relative with no parent-directory segments - a consumer resolves it against the index URL, so an absolute or escaping path would point off the site.

total.description: Visible items in the edition - the sum of its counts, excluding hidden. This is the '39 items' in the edition bar, so hide.py updates it here as well as in the edition.

generated_at.description: The edition's own generated_at, copied here so the bar can render 'updated 4h ago' without fetching the edition.
